chunks: My father (peace be upon him) and a group narrated to me from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn 'Ubayd, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Basri, from some of his men, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The clay of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) is a cure for every disease.
And when you eat it, say: 'In the name of Allah and by Allah.'
O Allah, make it (a cause of) extensive sustenance and beneficial knowledge and a cure from every disease.
Verily, You have power over all things.

key_terms.طِينُ قَبْرِ الْحُسَيْنِ: Clay of the grave of Husayn

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical benefit of eating the clay from Imam Husayn's grave according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith highlights the spiritual and physical barakah of the clay from Imam al-Husayn’s grave, a practice deeply rooted in Shia devotional culture. The prescribed supplication transforms the act of consumption into a holistic invocation for sustenance, knowledge, and healing, reflecting the Shia belief in the intercessory and purifying power of the Ahl al-Bayt. This practice underscores the concept of 'shifa' (healing) not merely as physical remedy but as a divine grace linked to the progeny of the Prophet.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā ibn ‘Ubayd, from Muḥammad ibn Ismā’īl Al-Basri, from some of his scholars, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
The clay of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) is a cure for every disease.
When you eat it, recite (the following):                   (I start) in the name of Allāh and by Allāh.
O Allāh! Make it (the cause of) extensive sustenance and beneficial knowledge (for me) and make it my cure from every disease.
Verily You have power over all things.
